title: Filipino-Style Express Chicken Adobo
description: A quick and energizing Filipino-inspired dish made with chicken and a blend of spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and bay leaves to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vinegar and water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the skillet and reduce heat to low.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with bay leaves if desired.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
